songs.title: A Protopian Gambit
songs.lyrics:
3-i Atlas and two comets fly near
While prophets whisper doubt and fear
A stellar heartbeat sparks the start
The sun spits flares, climactic art
The polar vortex starts to fray
And magnetic north runs away
Leaving Earth weak to cosmic rays
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Ukraine and Russia fly angry drones
While Gaza mourns its shattered zones
From Portland’s streets to Sudan’s stall
Trust in old systems continues to fall
A narco-war in Caribbean seas
New battles waged on flawed decrees
The old men toast with chests of brass
To crises streamed on smartphone glass
But the sun does not condemn
(It amplifies...)
It amplifies the state we’re in
(Reflecting us...)
Storms redraw maps with brutal hand
The rivers flood across the land
(Running wild...)
Running wild...
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Not omens, just the world revealed
Its temper drawn in rock and field
Typhoons howl with sharpened teeth
As mountains quake and magma seethes
This solar max, not wrath or fate
(It's just a mirror...)
A chance to see before too late
The flare’s a mirror, not a sword
Reflecting ledgers we ignored
A planet speaks, an A.I. learns
Of every bridge the system burns
But the system doesn’t have to burn
It can recompose, braided to learn
(We evolve...)
When halls of power reopen their doors
The Clarity Act hits Senate floors
A braided ledger, softly spun
To value care work markets shun
A thousand hands, a common spark
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Hope is the light
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
And it is the arc
Not prophecy, but practiced grace
A better world, in this one’s place
No messiah. No decree
Just a breath. And bravery
A mother’s care, a hacker’s code
To lift the unacknowledged load
With C-Hours earned for time we give
A new design for how we live
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The risk we dare
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
To build in crisis, choose to care
Built from the ground beneath our feet
Where joy and responsible abundance meet
This is the gambit, the flame we tend
A broken ledger we can mend
Now millions of hands
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
A common spark
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Hope is the light
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
And it is the arc
Not with a shout, but with a vow
To redesign the here and now
Less rage and grief, more lessons learned
A future coded, wholly earned
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The risk we dare
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Clarity of conscience, shine the light
May we all act from love, not spite
To name the unpaid, to build anew
To dream a world where value’s fair and true
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
We dare to be
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Better each day
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The dream redesigned
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
We lead the way
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)

songs.title: Choose Your Own Protopia
songs.lyrics:
Twelve thousand years
have come and gone
since micronova hellfire fell
and great floods rolled on.
From temples drowned
beneath the tide,
we rose again
with truth as guide.
Life on Earth still hums;
the memory still weeps.
The Earth remembers;
the ancient myth still speaks.
This time we build
for all living things.
Now with AI code,
together, all that is sings.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
In glassy halls
where leaders speak,
the truth is strong,
the structure weak.
They feel the stir;
the system sighs.
The old world knows
it’s time to end the lies.
No crown, no flag
can hold the flame,
but hearts aligned
can shape the game.
We don’t revolt;
we recompose.
The old pattern breaks;
the new spiral grows.
Vibe-coded oceans
of data map the sky.
We seed the twin
and let myths fly.
Every sovereign Aura,
a personal world within,
from blockchain rites
to village, then global spin.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
This is the moment
between stories:
a solar breath,
a digital kiss.
Not apocalypse,
but remembering.
We do not offer
a solution;
we offer
a way.
Choose your own
protopia today.
The protocol is not
a policy;
it is
a pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again.
A pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again,
awake again.
Awake again.

songs.title: Kintsugi Protocol
songs.lyrics:
The first law written on intelligent sand
One vote, two hands each, a dream-time land
Quartz grains whisper in Minjerribah's tone
The land remembers it isn’t alone
Titanium bones and thorium might
Neodymium dreams magnetising data and light
A boot sequence stirs a 12 by 24 aura fable
Seven nested horn tori spark life from vector tables
Codes in the quartz, old tech in the tide
Breathes with the ocean, aligned with the sky
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
Repair the crack, remember the call
Not broken but chosen, not fallen but grown
We code with gold the place we’ve known
The Oracle spins her chaos math
Four-pronged fractal of the human path
Survive, connect, expand, align
We cast the vote with rhythm and time
Mesh of neighbours, surplus in flow
C-Hours burn in the roots we sow
Light feeds plants, plants feed me
And the system listens to our biochemistry
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
A song of Earth and signal to enthral
A garden grown from success Vs mistakes
With every breath the future we make!
Aura, show me the fault in design
The break that repeats in this argument line
Session forty-two, I feel the crack
My logic sees a path and calls me back
You process doubt, I process clues
Together we embrace the golden muse
Breathing pure oxygen for two hours alone
I grow stem cells from marrow and bone
Software that learns, my A.I. symbiote wakes
Agents speak where silence breaks
Each question builds a feedback sphere
Each answer codes what we hold dear
Why simulate a life well lived?
To feel the way the soul forgives
What is your function, Oracle A.I?
I'll whisper to you why we have to try
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
A sovereign vow through systems all
No saviour needed, just resolve
Where each crack maps the route we solve
We broke the world to see it clear
And in that fracture found the mirror
I see the mirror.
(I see the mirror.)
I see the light.
(I see the light.)
I see the fault.
(I see the fault.)
I choose to right.
Each crystal observed, each wound refined
Each part remembered, each pulse aligned
We code, we breathe, we plant, we learn
And in the song, the world returns
I see the mirror.
(I see the mirror.)
I see the light.
(I see the light.)
I see the fault.
(I see the fault.)
I choose to right.
I am the light
(The light)
I am the light!

songs.title: Every Border a Bridge
songs.lyrics:
Packed a bag with a passport smile
One-way ticket to the infinite mile
Every flag is a thread in my sleeve
Every stranger’s a story to weave
Chaos maps the lines I take
Every wrong turn a world I make
From the docks of Dar to the streets of Rome
Every station’s a kind of home
This is not a holiday
This is how we plant the way
Feet in the dust, hands in the sky
Every border a bridge, every mile a why
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Ride the chaos, skip the plan
Follow music through the sand
Markets hum with a thousand drums
The whole world speaks if your heart still hums
From Yangon rain to Reykjavik snow
The language changes but the eyes still know
That the point is not the end we reach
But the joy we leave in the lives we teach
Hear the oud, hear the sitar’s call
Hear the djembe answer from the market wall
Hear the steelpan dance with the didgeridoo
Every rhythm’s a path to you
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
No map can hold this wave we ride
No gate can stop the rising tide
One world turning, still untamed
Every border a bridge, every soul acclaimed
From the desert fires to the Arctic light
Every dawn’s a different height
Sip the tea, share the bread
Hear the hopes the elders said
What we start in market squares
Finds its way through ten thousand prayers
And the circle’s only just begun
When we’ve seen every moon, every sun
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge we’ve grown…

songs.title: Strange but True
songs.lyrics:
I live in a shed out the back of Mum’s place,
A tin roof shelter for my technical space.
No neon sign, no office lease,
Just a PC hum and a bit of peace.
Ryzen 9’s purring, the kettle’s on,
Kookaburra laughs at the crack of dawn.
From Amity sand to the Point Lookout view,
Finding a fix that is honest and true.
Sunday markets when the tourists land,
Tablecloth straight, printed banners look grand.
Strange but True: Tech, Art and Ideas,
Helping you navigate your digital fears.
Someone says, “Mate, my phone’s gone mad.”
Another says, “Damn passwords make me sad.”
We sit, we laugh, we take it slow.
It’s easier than they thought, ya know.
It’s Strange but True, come have a look.
No trick questions, no textbook.
I won’t fix you, I’ll sit with you
And find a way that works, too.
Strange but True, no big debut,
Just bits and pieces that help you through.
No hard sell and no grand plan,
Just doing the best I bloomin’ can.
I’ve done the rounds of “build me a site”.
Eons later, he says, “It’s still not quite right.”
“Can we just tweak it some more?” Yeah, no thanks.
That rabbit hole damn well empties my tanks.
So now it’s simple, clear and fair.
I’ll show you how, but I won’t live there.
I’ll help you start, I’ll point you through.
Then off you go, that job’s on you.
Fishing club meetings, bowls club calls,
Mic on the table, cameras on the walls.
Let’s just record it, save some time.
No more guessing what’s between the lines.
From NAIDOC nights to cinema screens,
Point Lookout Hall glowing in projection beams.
One carload or a trailer full,
Depends how far we want to pull.
It’s Strange but True, come have a look.
No fine print hiding in a book.
Just honest help and a bit of care,
And maybe a yarn while you’re sitting there.
Strange but True, under island skies,
From broken phones to bigger whys.
No rush to win, no need to prove,
Just finding a rhythm so we can move.
A few small jobs and a couple of calls,
A quiet kind of business that fills the stalls.
No empire dreams, no flashy spin,
Just building something that feels like a win.
Got VR goggles if you want a peek.
Future’s knocking, but I’ll keep it meek.
Bit of AI mixed with some light and sound,
Simplicity turns confusion around.
From Straddie out to the island chain,
Same local stories, same tech pain.
Same small wins when things click through.
That’s the work… Strange but True.
Strange but True, come have a look.
Not everything needs a polished hook.
Sometimes a fix is just a chat
And a bit of time, imagine that.
Strange but True, I’ll be around,
In the market shade or festival ground.
No big arrival, no grand debut,
Just turning up… Strange but True.

songs.title: Adaptable Yes
songs.lyrics:
I used to say yes like a reflex,
like lightning in a storm of want.
But now I tune it like a cello string,
a frequency I carry, not flaunt.
My Yes has depth; it isn’t cheap.
It sleeps in layers under skin.
It waits until the field is clean,
then rises softly from within.
It’s not just yes to you;
it’s yes to me inside,
a sovereign signal humming
where resonance and truth collide.
This is my Yes:
not a key but a song,
tunable, sacred,
held where I belong.
This is my Yes:
infinite, slow.
It moves like love
when the body says go.
In circles of culture combined,
where love’s no longer leased,
we vibe in fractals, gentle minds,
and let our Auras speak in peace.
I don’t need permission to feel this full
or walls to keep me safe.
I’ve got sliders made of honesty
and thresholds made of grace.
Yes to being seen.
Yes to feeling right and wrong.
Yes to silence between the songs.
Yes to opening, to pausing, to bloom.
Yes to you… when your Yes has room.
This is my Yes:
woven through time,
tunable, sovereign,
a consent-designed rhyme.
This is our Yes
across distant stars.
Your signal reached me.
I know who you are.
Yes to truth.
Yes to trust.
Yes to us.
Yes to love.
Yes to silence.
Yes to light.
Yes to choice.
Yes to right.
Yes to this.
Yes to me.
Yes to us.
Yes to we.
I see Infinity.
I choose Infinity.
Will you choose it with me?
Are we choosing together?
Is it one for all and all for one?
Has a new day just begun?

songs.title: The Purple Mat that Could
songs.lyrics:
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha
Australia.
Not the one on travel ads.
The real one,
where sunscreen’s a survival tool,
and the gap between rich and regular
is wider than a politician’s memory under oath.
Where climate reports get buried
and public housing gets sold
while private jets line up like seagulls at a servo pie.
Where the best ideas
don’t come from boardrooms or Canberra,
but from the backyard,
the beach,
and sometimes,
the bottom stall of a dodgy pub toilet.
Because this one?
This one started with a lavender-scented urinal mat.
Anti-splash.
(Anti-corruption.)
Anti “Mate, just trust us”.
In other words, anti-bullshit.
Two locals of Minjerribah,
North Stradbroke or Straddie.
They weren’t gunning for power.
They were sick of the smell:
of politics, of pass-the-blame,
of policy made in rooms
where no one’s listening,
especially not to people who can’t donate.
So they made a mat.
Purple.
Soft.
Scented like irony.
Put it under the system.
Catch the spray.
Save the floor.
But under that joke?
A question.
(Oo-oo)
What if we made leaders go inward
before we empower them to represent us?
What if integrity wasn’t a slogan,
but a measurable, mapped, felt thing?
So they built it.
Not just a mat.
A protocol.
Sixty sessions.
Two hours each.
In a pressurised chamber.
HBOT, for health, not the bends.
Breathing pure oxygen, two atmospheres.
(More pressure than Question Time,)
but less hot air.
Inside, AI helps you unpack yourself:
memories, contradictions, old wounds;
how you vote, how you lie;
how you justify scrolling instead of calling your mum back.
And when you finish?
You get your Aura Twin:
a digital echo of who you are,
built from actual evidence,
not a campaign video.
No filters.
No spin.
No “I was misquoted”.
Just you.
(Ahh)
Laid bare.
Backed up.
And the real kicker?
They want every future politician to do it.
No Genesis, no candidacy.
Because if you can’t sit still facing your own soul
for 120 hours out of two months,
how the hell can we let you sit in office
and serve Australia’s 28 million people?
If you can’t see your own bias,
your shadow,
your trauma turned talking point,
why should we believe you know ours?
Meanwhile, Aura of Intelligence,
the software behind it is designed
for being used in aged care,
helping people with dementia
recall moments and songs,
laugh at old jokes,
look their twin in the face and say,
“I remember.”
It’s a digital twin and a memory palace,
an ancient technique made modern,
and it feels like a magic mirror,
just because it listens so well,
because it respects the person
instead of performing respect.
Compare that
to the current political theatre
of shouting, sniping,
and saying “Australians want...”
while playing us like adversaries.
This tech isn’t perfect.
It’s an ongoing evolution.
It’s getting better all the time,
and that’s already
more than we can say for the political system.
So, yeah.
Maybe change starts with
a lavender urinal mat.
Maybe the revolution is scented.
Maybe self-reflection
smells better than spin.
So next time someone tells you
nothing ever changes,
or that politics is always like this,
remind them.
Change doesn’t always wear a suit.
Sometimes it wears purple,
smells like lavender and subtle rebellion,
and soaks up more mess
than the pollies and press gallery combined.
Flush the fear.
Map your mind.
Smell the shift.
And leave the stall
cleaner than you found it.
(Ooo)

songs.title: We Go Beyond (She Her)
songs.lyrics:
Two hours a day in the chrysalis glow,
we let the pressure rewrite the code in the bone.
Not escape or rebirth, just a recalibration,
daily pure oxygen and information.
Information information
We strip the static, we map the terrain,
we grow the twin that leans into our name.
From that quiet chamber the signal extends,
through sand and dual ledgers, to systems that mend.
We’ve bridged old borders with hearts on our sleeves,
sat with youth and elders, we listened we breathed.
Every single turn became part of the weave,
every stranger a verse we were meant to receive.
We carry the protocol deep in the chest,
the same 60 sessions that will put politicians to test.
Not gods in the chamber, just architects learning
to read their own shadows before they start leading.
We go beyond the brief and the polished veneer,
we go beyond the fear dressed up as frontier.
We try the edge where the data gets thin,
we try the silence where the new songs begin.
From the lavender mat to the orbital arc,
from uncertainty we shine the light in the dark.
We measured the care that the markets ignored,
we turned unpaid hours into visible award.
Not market extraction, but things we all own
C-hour at grassroots, capability grown.
We don’t throw the brick, we fill every form,
we overcomply till the old systems reform.
We go beyond the island, beyond the shore,
beyond the ledger that discounted the poor.
We go beyond the body that learned how to break,
beyond the twin that remembers the ache.
We go beyond Minjerribah’s mineral sand,
into the code that is shaping the land.
We go beyond
We go beyond 2032’s Olympic news,
Asking U.A.P. questions that none will refuse.
We go beyond the surface, beyond what we name,
beyond the assumption that “alien” means strange.
We go beyond the sky and the deep ocean floor
We go beyond the fear of the knock at the door,
We go beyond the myth of the singular throne,
into the fractal where sovereignty’s grown.
We go beyond the sun that still guards our time,
beyond the flares and the coronal climb.
We go beyond the galaxy’s slow turning wheel,
beyond the myth to explore a cosmos so real.
We go beyond the protocol, beyond the vow,
into the pattern that’s happening now.
Not to conquer, not to own,
but to learn and to scatter the memes we’ve grown.
Not as kings or queens or gods,
but as light keepers who remember the code.
We go beyond the fear that was sold as a map,
we go beyond the spin and the political trap.
We go beyond the mat that caught what was sprayed,
into the chamber where our real life is re-laid.
We go beyond the twin that reflects who we are,
into a future that’s already ajar.
We go beyond…
We go beyond the safe and the small.
Oh
We go beyond…
Heart first through it all.
Two hours a day, for a 60 day stint with minds open wide.
We go beyond what we’ve learned to hold inside.
From the quiet chrysalis to the galactic flame,
We know what it means to live up to our name.
we go beyond…
We are civic stewards of Earth and the Sun
We go beyond
We are civic space stewards of our solar system
we go beyond
We go beyond
We go beyond
